notes: All 64 legacy HTML fragments have executable literal AST fixtures below; tests assert actual text, structural classes, immutable inputs and deterministic output.
The offline .xsu fixture is representative; image and connected Mermaid cases are literal nodes in this manifest and use an injected reader.

All 90 registered variants were compared in Chrome at desktop/mobile and light/dark against the immutable pre-XSU shell revision; generated component HTML is shared between both sides, so this proves shell preservation rather than independent legacy-fragment DOM equivalence.
Legacy badge-info and badge-danger have no template CSS; info uses existing badge-progress styling with data-status=info, and danger maps to blocked.
